If You Build It, Will They Compost? The Effects of Municipal Composting Services on Household Waste Disposal and Landfill Emissions
abstract: Landfills are the third largest source of human-related methane emissions. Composting food and garden organic waste generates significantly less methane emissions than landfills, yet the majority of organic waste is sent to landfills or incinerated. This paper examines how local government provision of composting services affects the amount of household waste going to landfills. Specifically, we examine the quasi-random adoption of curbside organics collection by local councils in New South Wales, Australia. Using council-level waste disposal data from 2008–2015 and an event study design, we find that curbside organics collection diverted 4.2 kg of waste per household per week from the landfill stream into the composting stream, one-fourth of the household waste sent to landfill prior to curbside organics collection. We find no evidence that curbside organics collection altered total household waste levels and little to no evidence of spillovers on dry-recycling waste. Back-of-the-envelope calculations reveal curbside organics collection could reduce greenhouse gas emissions from landfills by 6–26%.
abstract_zh: 垃圾填埋场是人为甲烷排放的第三大来源。与垃圾填埋相比，堆肥处理食物和园林有机废弃物所产生的甲烷排放显著更少，然而大部分有机废弃物仍被送往垃圾填埋场或焚烧。本文考察地方政府提供堆肥服务如何影响运往垃圾填埋场的家庭废弃物数量。具体而言，我们考察了澳大利亚新南威尔士州地方议会准随机地采用路边有机物收集服务的情况。利用2008至2015年的议会层面废弃物处理数据，并采用事件研究设计，我们发现路边有机物收集使每户每周从填埋废弃物流中分流出4.2千克废弃物并转入堆肥流，相当于该服务实施前每户运往填埋场的家庭废弃物的四分之一。我们没有发现证据表明路边有机物收集改变了家庭废弃物的总量，对可回收干废弃物的溢出效应也几乎没有或完全没有证据。粗略估算显示，路边有机物收集可使填埋场的温室气体排放减少6%至26%。

title: Reduce, Reuse, Redeem: Consumer Valuation of California Recycling Options
Recycling Behavior and Convenience
venue: Book chapter: Sustainable Resource Development in the 21st Century
abstract: This chapter provides a comprehensive review of the current state of California’s recycling policies. Specifically, we focus on the demand side of the recycling system and summarize some of the evidence around the efficacy of the California Department of Recycling’s (CalRecycle) deposit-refund recycling program – in conjunction with other recycling alternatives, such as curbside recycling pickup – in providing convenient recycling options to consumers. In Sect. 2, we provide some relevant background on recycling policy in California. In Sect. 3, we discuss the findings in Berck et al. (2021), which uses survey data to empirically assess who recycles and how the public defines convenience in recycling opportunities. Next, in Sect. 4, we present the main takeaways from Berck et al. (2020), which focuses on the consumer survey evidence to estimate California residents’ preferences and willingness to pay (WTP) for current beverage container recycling methods, including curbside pickup services, drop-off at government-subsidized recycling centers, and drop-off at non-subsidized centers. Finally, in Sect. 5, we discuss avenues for future research.
abstract_zh: 本章全面回顾了加利福尼亚州回收政策的现状。具体而言，我们关注回收体系的需求侧，并总结了关于加州回收部（CalRecycle）押金退款回收计划的有效性的部分证据，该计划与路边回收收集等其他回收方式共同为消费者提供便捷的回收选择。在第2节，我们提供了加州回收政策的相关背景。在第3节，我们讨论了Berck等人（2021）的研究发现，该研究利用调查数据实证评估了谁在回收，以及公众如何界定回收渠道的便利性。接下来，在第4节，我们介绍了Berck等人（2020）的主要结论，该研究基于消费者调查证据，估计加州居民对当前饮料容器回收方式的偏好及支付意愿，这些方式包括路边上门收集服务、在政府补贴的回收中心投递，以及在非补贴回收中心投递。最后，在第5节，我们讨论了未来的研究方向。

title: The impact of ecolabels and green taxes on market outcomes
venue: Book chapter: Blue Planet Law: The Ecology of our Economic and Technological World
abstract: Ecolabels and green taxes aim to achieve more sustainable market outcomes by affecting suppliers’ production and sales behaviour, consumers’ purchasing behaviour, or both. In this chapter, we present the economic rationale for how these approaches may impact suppliers and consumers in various settings and review recent published empirical research on the topic. We focus specifically on examples where ecolabels and green taxes have been used to protect oceans and fisheries by reducing plastic waste and reducing purchases of less sustainable seafood. We conclude by discussing other possible policy instruments and highlight important avenues for future work in pursuing more sustainable market outcomes.
abstract_zh: 生态标签与绿色税收旨在通过影响供应商的生产与销售行为、消费者的购买行为，或二者兼而有之，以实现更加可持续的市场结果。在本章中，我们阐述了这些手段在不同情境下可能影响供应商和消费者的经济学逻辑，并回顾了关于该主题的近期已发表的实证研究。我们特别关注生态标签与绿色税收被用于保护海洋和渔业的案例，即通过减少塑料废弃物以及减少对可持续性较差海产品的购买。最后，我们讨论了其他可能的政策工具，并指出了未来在追求更可持续市场结果方面的重要研究方向。

Recycling Policies, Behavior and Convenience: Survey Evidence from the CalRecycle Program
abstract: AB2020 established a deposit‐refund system in California, where consumers are reimbursed the California Redemption Value (CRV) upon recycling eligible containers at a recycling center. We study recycling under this policy, focusing on consumer convenience, reported recycling and diversion behavior, and responses to changes in the CRV amount. We find that consumers prefer nearby centers with flexible operating hours and short waiting times. While the CRV induces recycling, an increase in CRV would not lead to major recycling increases, given the limited number of containers entering trash streams. Finally, most diverted containers are taken from trash streams, not curbside recycling bins.
abstract_zh: AB2020法案在加利福尼亚州建立了押金退款制度，消费者在回收中心回收合格容器后，可获得加州回收价值（CRV）的返还。我们研究了该政策下的回收行为，重点关注消费者的便利性、自我报告的回收与分流行为，以及对CRV金额变动的反应。我们发现，消费者偏好营业时间灵活、等待时间较短的近距离回收中心。尽管CRV能够促进回收，但鉴于进入垃圾流的容器数量有限，提高CRV不会带来回收量的大幅增加。最后，大多数被分流的容器来自垃圾流，而非路边回收箱。

Willingness to Pay for Low Water Footprint Food Choices During Drought
venue: Book chapter: Agricultural Productivity and Producer Behavior
abstract: In the context of recent California drought years, we investigate empirically whether consumers are willing to pay for more efficient water usage in the production of four California agricultural products. We implement an internet survey choice experiment for avocados, almonds, lettuce, and tomatoes to elicit consumer valuation for water efficiency via revealed choices. We estimate a model of consumer choices where a product is defined as a bundle of three attributes: price, production method (conventional or organic), and water usage (average or efficient).Varying the attribute space presented to consumers in the experimental choice design gives us the data variation to estimate a discrete choice model-both conditional logit specifications and random coefficient mixed logit specifications. We find that on average consumers have a significant positive marginal utility towards water-efficiency and estimate that there is an implied positive willingness to pay (WTP) of about 12 cents per gallon of water saved on average. Moreover, informing consumers about the drought severity increases the WTP for low water footprint options, but not significantly. We find that there is heterogeneity in the WTP along respondents' education, race, and also with respect to stated environmental concern. Our findings have policy implications in that they suggest there to be a market based potential to nudge consumers who want to decrease their water footprint and follow a more sustainable diet, namely, by revealing information on the product's water footprint in a form of a label. Simulations of removing low water footprint labels from the choice set attributes imply significant consumer surplus losses, especially for the more educated, white, and more environmentally concerned respondents.
abstract_zh: 结合近年加州干旱的背景，我们实证考察了消费者是否愿意为加州四种农产品生产中更高的用水效率支付更高价格。我们针对牛油果、杏仁、生菜和番茄实施了一项网络调查选择实验，通过显示偏好的方式获取消费者对用水效率的估值。我们将产品定义为三种属性的组合：价格、生产方式（常规或有机）以及用水量（平均或高效），并估计了消费者选择模型。在实验选择设计中，通过改变呈现给消费者的属性空间，我们获得了估计离散选择模型所需的数据变异，包括条件logit设定和随机系数混合logit设定。我们发现，消费者平均而言对用水效率具有显著为正的边际效用，并估计每节约一加仑水，平均隐含的正向支付意愿（WTP）约为12美分。此外，告知消费者干旱的严重程度会提高其对低水足迹选项的支付意愿，但这一提高并不显著。我们发现，支付意愿在受访者的教育程度、种族以及其所表达的环境关切方面存在异质性。我们的研究结果具有政策含义：它们表明，通过以标签形式揭示产品的水足迹信息，可能存在基于市场的潜力，以推动那些希望减少水足迹并践行更可持续饮食的消费者做出选择。模拟显示，若从选择集中移除低水足迹标签，将造成显著的消费者剩余损失，对受教育程度较高、白人以及环境关切程度较高的受访者而言尤为明显。

title: Diffusion of Drip Irrigation: The Case of California
abstract: This article provides insights regarding the state of the literature on the economics of drip irrigation adoption and diffusion. Our literature review finds that the methodological approaches to studying diffusion—conceptual modeling, empirical analysis, and historical narratives—are complementary, yet historical analyses have been underemphasized. To address this gap, we conduct a historical analysis of the diffusion of drip irrigation in California. Our forty‐five‐year narrative highlights that the successful adoption of drip irrigation to diverse crops and locations required (i) coevolution of the technology and complementary production processes, and (ii) joint efforts by private and public experts at the local level.
abstract_zh: 本文就滴灌采用与扩散的经济学文献现状提供了见解。我们的文献综述发现，研究扩散的方法（概念建模、实证分析和历史叙述）具有互补性，但历史分析一直未得到充分重视。为弥补这一缺口，我们对加州滴灌的扩散进行了历史分析。我们长达四十五年的叙述表明，滴灌技术要成功应用于多样化的作物与地点，需要（i）技术与配套生产流程的协同演进，以及（ii）地方层面私营与公共专家的共同努力。
